summary_1line: Bhima and Karna fight fiercely; Bhima repeatedly wrecks Karna’s chariot and kills Durmukha, forcing Karna to withdraw despite stubborn resistance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima hurls a massive golden six-sided mace that smashes Karna’s horses and wrecks his chariot amid the chaos of battle.
Karna stands on the battlefield without chariot, bow drawn, still resisting Bhima while arrows streak through the sky around him.
Durmukha lies slain on the blood-soaked field as Karna, tearful, walks around the fallen prince before returning to battle.
